newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt airport Cargo City South to open May 4.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt airport Cargo City South to open May 4.

text.p: The new Frankfurt airport Cargo City South complex will launch operations on Sunday, May 4, operator and owner Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
The first aircraft to be handled will be a Cathay Pacific Airways Boeing 747 freighter, operated in conjunction with Lufthansa Cargo AG, due to arrive at 6.25 p.m. (1625 GMT).
The newly-opened 120 million mark FAG cargo terminal will go into full operation from Monday, May 5, FAG said.
Some 70 airlines will complete moves from the present FAG cargo buildings on the north side of Frankfurt airport to the southern complex during May and June, market sources said.
Lufthansa Cargo AG will then expand its own Frankfurt air cargo centre with the opening of new facilities over the coming months.
